info.name: London Stock Exchange Group Get the CaseTemplate for the given Group

params.name: groupId
params.description: Group ID under which we wish to manage Cases and perform screening

items.docs:
Get the CaseTemplate for the given Group, used for constructing a Case

**Available secondary fields:**
<details>
  <summary>Click here to expand</summary>

  | Type ID   | NAME                    | VALUE                     |
  |--|-||
  | SFCT_1    | GENDER                  | MALE, FEMALE, UNSPECIFIED |
  | SFCT_2    | DATE OF BIRTH           | DATE                      |
  | SFCT_3    | COUNTRY LOCATION        | COUNTRY CODE              |
  | SFCT_4    | PLACE OF BIRTH          | COUNTRY COD

for a Case belonging to the given Group `groupId`.
